themes.name: Fired & Flooded
themes.description: Morning light on wet zellige — terracotta geometry, mineral blue, and bone-white surfaces arranged with the irregular confidence of hand-cut tile.

props.text: Morning light on wet zellige. Terracotta geometry meets mineral blue — the irregular confidence of hand-cut tile, translated into every outlined card and retro footer.
Hand-cut surfaces, mineral clarity, terracotta warmth bleeding into bone-white silence.

themes.name: Foxed Pages
themes.description: A scholarly dawn index rendered in autumn library tones — burgundy rulings, mustard marginalia, and the quiet authority of aged leather bindings.

props.text: The margins are where the real thinking happens. Autumn light through library glass, rulings in burgundy, notes in mustard — a day that smells of old paper and quiet authority.
Aged leather bindings carry the quiet authority of a hundred annotated winters.
§ bracket links · outlined cards · 2px radius · grid texture

themes.name: Overexposed Vellichor
themes.description: Late-night gallery stillness filtered through faded instant film — bleached surfaces, deep shadow pools, and a single magenta pulse holding everything together.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: A gallery closes at midnight. The overheads cut out. One magenta exit sign bleeds across bleached walls — and you remember everything you forgot to feel.
The instant photograph knows something the eye refuses — that light always costs something.

themes.name: Harbour Proof
themes.description: A Baltic editorial stillness — fogged linen pages, ice-cold type hierarchy, and one precise signal red anchoring the silence.

props.text: Fogged linen. Ice-cold hierarchy. One red flare cutting through harbour silence.
Still water. Sharp type. One red anchor.

themes.name: Last Set Standing
themes.description: Dense typographic rhythm against oxblood and tarnished brass — a poster pulled off a smoky wall at closing time.

props.text: Oxblood ink and tarnished brass. The poster still clings to the wall — set list smeared, smoke-thick air, last call already called. This is typographic survival.
Dense rhythm. No apologies. The wall keeps the memory when the crowd forgets.

themes.name: Slab & Canopy
themes.description: A Niemeyer terrace frozen at peak afternoon — broad geometric shadow, equatorial color, and sculptural type with nowhere to hide.

props.text: A Niemeyer terrace frozen at peak afternoon — broad geometric shadow, equatorial color, and sculptural type with nowhere to hide.
Form follows the sun on a Niemeyer terrace — Lora grounds the body while Unbounded carves the sky.

themes.name: Wet Pavement Grid
themes.description: Memphis geometry filtered through rain-soaked city reflection — clashing primaries on a cool-tinted ground, sharp ruled lines, and dense typographic structure that hums with morning voltage.

body.name: IBM Plex Mono
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace

props.text: Memphis geometry. Rain-soaked asphalt. Primary colors bleeding into cold morning light — structured, loud, and humming with voltage.
